text_block_list.text:
In the Trainer's office late at night, the 
members from back then had gathered once 
again.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So this is it—the venue for the twisting, 
turning, curving tournament.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've cooked up a special twist just for 
this~.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You are taking this way too far! Why must 
you act like this, especially today of all 
days...?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Today is the big day when Orfe-san takes 
on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!"

"Yes, today is finally... the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Still, there is immense anticipation, 
isn't there? I believe they are even 
hosting public viewings in movie theaters, 
yes?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I hear they're very popular locally as 
well... It seems their reputation has 
echoed all the way over there.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Wouldn't taking a gamble have been fine 
too?

The last time we gathered in this 
trainer's room... we watched her first 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe attempt, 
witnessing her closest finish yet in 2nd 
place.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You never know how things'll turn out 
until it's over. Wouldn't have made a 
difference even if you were the one who 
went.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, that's precisely why... I 
understand you chose what was best, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Everyone. Orfe has come out.

Standing proudly in the paddock, 
Orfevre... basked in the Parisian 
sunlight, and even through the screen... 
shone brighter than anyone else.

The words slipped out before I could stop 
them. The unnameable anxiety I'd felt 
until now was purified by Orfevre's 
radiance.

I clutch the gold filigree pendant I 
intended to bring with me. Filled with 
trust... hoping it will reach her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. You've got a good look in your 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, King. Don't go taking gambles. If 
you're a king, act like one... Show them 
your strength."

And so, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
began.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, Japan's Orfevre is currently second 
from the back. She has chosen to race from 
behind.

Orfevre holds back behind the pack, 
patiently biding her time and reading the 
situation. From what I can see, she's 
remarkably composed...
choice_data_list: (Hang in there, just a little more...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And here comes Orfevre from the outside! 
Orfevre takes the lead! Just 200 meters to 
glory!!

From the moment Orfevre accelerated to the 
goal, those few dozen seconds... At that 
very instant, everyone across Japan was 
screaming.

text_block_list.name: Woman A & Man B
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaa!! Go for itーーーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOH!! Orfevre, here she comes, 
here she comes!! WIN THIS THING~~!!

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Meno
text_block_list.text: Goooooooo for it--!!

However... that wild excitement suddenly 
turned into screams.

It was truly so sudden. As if guided by 
something—she plunged straight into the 
inner rail.
And...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Orfevre...! —Finished in second...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Passed by a fraction at the wire!! 
Japan's dream has vanished just steps 
before the goal...! Orfevre finishes in 
second!!"

"A heavy silence hung over the Trainer's 
office. With no one uttering a single 
word... Nakayama Festa murmured quietly."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ... A dream is just a dream, huh...

—Before I knew it, I was alone. The weight 
of her defeat pressed heavily upon my 
heart.
choice_data_list:
(Isn't that exactly the same as that 
dream...?)
(It's exactly the same as that dream...)

text_block_list.text:
"In the end, my changing... brought no 
meaning to the outcome whatsoever. —If 
that's the case, if only I had gone with 
her..."

She immediately brushed aside the rising 
regret. That would be entirely 
meaningless... just what-ifs. Either way, 
her challenge was over.
choice_data_list: Let's at least give them a warm welcome.

text_block_list.text:
"—With the defeat of Orfevre, the 
strongest Umamusume in Japan at the 
time... a heavy mood of despair hung over 
the public."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I guess this year was no good either, 
huh... ...If even Orfevre couldn't do it, 
then there's no hope...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Can't we just stop obsessing over the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe? Japanese Umamusume 
are already top tier, so there's no need 
to force ourselves into conditions that 
don't suit us...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—...It's frustrating, isn't it... That 
margin at the wire...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe-senpai... I wonder if she'll be 
alright."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: No way... ...It can't be.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Orfe-san...

A few days later—Orfevre cut her schedule 
short to return home, and I rushed over to 
meet her.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I am terribly sorry. Even though 
you entrusted your precious Umamusume to 
me...

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text: My sincerest apologies.
choice_data_list: No, I truly appreciate your efforts.

text_block_list.text:
His sincerity comes through clearly in his 
expression and demeanor. There is no doubt 
he gave it his absolute best. This outcome 
is something everyone involved must 
shoulder together.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She is... in silence. Not a single word 
since the defeat. She's being very, very 
quiet.

"—Our eyes met. And... I saw a fire ignite 
within them."

At that moment, I realized. The fury 
harboring within Orfevre—all of it had 
just been unleashed.
